Ex-IMF Director Disputes Pakistan's World Bank Leadership Claim

An ex-International Monetary Fund (IMF) director has challenged Pakistan's assertion of a 'historic' leadership role with the World Bank. The claim, which Pakistan presented as a significant achievement, was described as being based on 'protocol, not power' by an Indian finance commentator. This individual, identified as an 'Indian Finance Hawk', stated that the World Bank leadership claim was a 'lie'.
